searchTerm.title: Search term
searchTerm.description: Job title to search for, e.g. "Data Engineer".

location.title: Location
location.description: Where to search. Free text, e.g. "Austin, TX" or "Berlin".

sites.title: Job boards
sites.description: Boards to scrape. Each one is scraped and retried independently.

resultsWanted.title: Results per board
resultsWanted.description: Maximum postings to request from each board.

hoursOld.title: Posted within (hours)
hoursOld.description: Only keep postings newer than this many hours.

countryIndeed.title: Indeed country
countryIndeed.description: Country used for Indeed's search, e.g. USA, UK, germany.

attempts.title: Attempts per board
attempts.description: How many times to try a board before giving up. Retries rotate through the proxy pool.

backoff.title: Backoff (seconds)
backoff.description: Base delay between attempts; grows linearly (2s, 4s, 6s...).

useProxies.title: Use free proxies on retries
useProxies.description: Validate a small pool of free proxies and rotate them when a board blocks the direct request. Disable for fast, deterministic runs.

poolSize.title: Proxy pool size
poolSize.description: How many working proxies to keep validated.
